newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand sets bht/dlr reference at 28.189.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand sets bht/dlr reference at 28.189.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Friday set its daily baht weighted average interbank rate at 28.189 to the dollar, compared with 27.383 on Thursday.
The reference rate was the second set by the central bank after it announced on Wednesday it would let the baht move according to a new managed float regime.
The baht was trading at 28.20 in the offshore market and 28.00 in the domestic market after the rate was announced.
The baht fell about 15 percent on Wednesday after Thailand abandoned its earlier long-standing practice of fixing the currency to a dollar-dominated basket of foreign currencies.
The daily reference rate is based on the baht's traded average on the previous business day.
The Bank of Thailand said on Wednesday the weighted average rate is announced primarily as a reference for tax and accounting purposes when private business deals with government agencies.
The Bank of Thailand also published a list of average rates quoted by commercial banks at the close of business. These rates reflect the customer rate given at exchange counters.
